exposure: Two-stage ultrasound screening for vasa previa (at 11-13 weeks and 20-22 weeks gestation)
Women with velamentous cord insertion at the inferior part of the placenta at the first-trimester scan
Women with low-lying placenta at the second-trimester scan
cohort: 26,830 singleton pregnancies at the Fetal Medicine Unit at Medway Maritime Hospital, UK, between 2012 and 2018
finding: A two-stage ultrasound screening strategy effectively detected all cases of vasa previa (21/26,830) at the 20-22 week scan, potentially preventing 10.6% of stillbirths.
mod_finding: All cases of vasa previa were managed with elective Cesarean section at 34 weeks' gestation.
